test: decompengine.acp.AcpAgentHarnessTest.public ACP reconstruction enforces mutation grants and preserves publication on limit outcomes
command: DECOMP_REQUIRE_LIVE_ACP_CONTRACT=1 ./gradlew --offline test --console=plain -x verifyFrontendToolchain -x frontendInstall -x frontendBuild --tests 'decompengine.acp.AcpAgentHarnessTest.public ACP reconstruction enforces mutation grants and preserves publication on limit outcomes'

scope.provider: scripted ACP process with host-side final-snapshot injection
scenarios: invalid UTF-8 after an acknowledged authorized write
valid source one byte above the declared 256 KiB mutation grant
symlink replacement of the acknowledged target to a file outside the staged workspace
hard-link creation for the acknowledged target with the external name retained
scope.receipt: Each invocation-bound receipt is request- and turn-bound, reports WORKSPACE_VIOLATION during final-workspace-snapshot, and has no complete execution evidence.
scope.cleanup: The process is stopped, no owned processes remain, sandbox cleanup is verified, and the rejected staged publication leaves accepted output metadata unchanged with no publication residue. Symlink and hard-link outside files retain their bytes.
qualificationLimits: host-side injection is not an agent-accessible mutation
does not qualify mutation after the final snapshot or publication-time revalidation under #732
does not qualify metadata/xattr/FIFO/socket mutation classes
